liner.body_md:
## The recordings

- **gd71-02-19.sbd.orf.1029.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 21 songs; 161 min; rated 4.36/5 by 11 [1]. Said about its sound: Smokestack is nice, and the third disk flows very nicely; This copy is cleaner than other nights, showing the extraordinary quality of the Betty Boards; Pigpen guides the band through a tight, harmonically perfect, cosmic jam [7][8][10][14][15]
- **gd71-02-19.matrix.chappell.31210.sbeok.flacf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 159 min; rated 4.27/5 by 11 [2]. Said about its sound: Clear vocals and instruments, mixed with a feisty crowd of about 200 people [17]
- **gd1971-02-19.151881.soundboard.ramrod.miller.flac1644**: soundboard; 21 songs; 167 min; rated 3.5/5 by 4 [3]
- **gd1971-02-19.aud.Vadnais.30230.flac16**: audience recording; 22 songs; 134 min; rated 3.56/5 by 9 [4]. Said about its sound: Modern technical assistance elevates this initial taper attempt to an above-average audience recording; Download I Know You Rider to hear the audience going crazy [11][12]

## Around the show

- Recording begins with tuning and tinkering before the band plays Truckin' [17]
- Partial audience recording, likely made by a balcony worker with microphones [5]
- Reviewer preferred the February 18 and 24 shows over this one [7]
- The February 18 show is the most popular of the run due to its set list [8]
- This night marks the end of the heavier concerts of 1971 [13]
- If February 18 is the classic, February 19 is its companion [15]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd71-02-19.sbd.orf.1029.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Reviewer acquired this tape in the 80s, trading with Dr. Flashback; Transferred from 7-inch two-track BBD reel with Dolby A at 7.5 ips [1][9]
- **gd71-02-19.matrix.chappell.31210.sbeok.flacf**: transferred by Clinton Vadnais and Chris Chappell; source: Matrix [2]
- **gd1971-02-19.151881.soundboard.ramrod.miller.flac1644**: taped by Ramrod; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  February 26, 2021; source: SBD > Master Reel (Sony TC-770/Scotch 7in 1/4 track 7.5ips) [3]. Also: Source is not the Betty board, coming from a different set of reels [3]
- **gd1971-02-19.aud.Vadnais.30230.flac16**: transferred by Clinton Vadnais; source: Audience [4]

## Art and photos

- Poster by crepuscularthad.blogspot.com: [Brokedown Palace: The Capitol Theatre and the Grateful Dead](https://crepuscularthad.blogspot.com/2017/03/capitol-theatre-and-grateful-dead.html) [20]
